text:
lia: i pushed two quick variants for the streaming control: Variant Split (Stop | Regenerate) and Variant Compact (single toggle -> Retry). screenshots attached. thoughts? kevin: split for clarity. separate buttons reduce accidental regenerates when users try to stop. maria: agree. product question: when Stop is used, keep partial text editable or clear it? impacts edit+rerun flows. lia: keep partial text visible and editable. Stop = interrupt; Regenerate starts a fresh response unless user edited. jon: token counter is noisy if it updates every chunk. proposal: show "sent / limit" and throttle UI updates (smooth animation) so numbers don't flash. tasha: infra recommendation: throttle token updates to 200ms and only emit at chunk boundaries to avoid telemetry blowup. lia: a11y: use aria-labels for buttons (e.g., aria-label="Stop generation") instead of changing visible text to "Interrupt". and add tooltip with shortcut (Esc). jon: streaming container should use aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false" so SRs don't read every chunk. snippet:
...
kevin: copy: keep "Regenerate" but tooltip = "Generate a fresh response from the same prompt." maria: prompt drawer: push on desktop, overlay on mobile. preserve pinned-bottom scrolling during push. lia: decision: A/B test Split vs Compact for 2 weeks. both use 200ms token throttle, aria-live, tooltips, aria-labels. I'll file the experiment ticket and add mocks + acceptance criteria. :white_check_mark: ops-bot: FYI: streaming client rollout to staging Fri 11:30 PDT (small canary).
